pr-review-comment.description: Review comments on all open PRs — checks Sourcery reviews and lists issues found
pr-review-comment.prompt:
I need you to review the comments on all open PRs in this repository. Follow these steps:

1. Run `gh pr list --state open --json number,title,headRefName` to list all open PRs
2. For each PR, run `gh pr view <number> --comments` to read the comments
3. For each PR, summarize:
   - Any issues raised (typos, bugs, refactoring suggestions)
   - How many issues total
   - Whether there's a Sourcery review and what it found
4. Group the findings by PR
5. Prioritize: put critical issues (bugs, breaking changes, type errors) at the top

Do NOT address the issues yet — just report them. I will decide which ones to fix.

Return a clean summary in markdown.
